title: Streamlined 'First-Call' Path for SDKs, Docs, and Quickstarts
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Reduce time and friction from signup to a successful first API call for new developers by creating a single, opinionated 'First-Call' path spanning SDK examples, quickstart repos, and condensed docs. Goal: make the canonical path reproducible in < 10 minutes for a developer with basic Python/JS experience.

Scope:
- Canonical quickstart repo per language (Python, Node) with minimal dependencies and a ready-made token injection pattern for hosted and Private variants.
- 2-page condensed quickstart doc (Get API key, make first call, validate response).
- One-click deployable examples (Replit/Glitch templates) and a local CLI helper to validate environment and tokens.
- SDK wrappers and README hygiene: copy-paste snippets, consistent error messages, and a single 'hello world' flow.
- Instrumentation hooks to emit metrics to Console for: time-to-first-call, first-call success rate, and common failure categories.

Success metrics (target in 8 weeks):
- Time-to-first-call median <= 10 minutes for new signups (measured via onboarding funnel).
- First-call success rate >= 90% across top 3 languages.
- Activation conversion (first-call -> API usage in 7 days) uplift +12%.

Out-of-scope for this ticket: in-depth tutorials, advanced SDK features, enterprise onboarding flows (handled in Dedicated track).

Stakeholders:
- Product: Aisha Patel (owner), Miguel Ortega (DM)
- Eng: Runtime + SDK teams (primary impl), Infra (metrics hooks)
- Design: Pattern library & microcopy reviews
- Docs: Quickstart condensation and localization pipeline

Milestones:
1) Requirements & success metrics validation (2 weeks)
2) Prototype quickstart repos + SDK snippets (3 weeks)
3) Instrumentation + Console dashboard (2 weeks)
4) Beta cohort + analytics review (1 week)
5) Public launch and monitoring (ongoing)
